description: A European company's annual financial report as it filed it in the European Single Electronic Format (ESEF): revenue, operating and net profit, EPS, assets, equity, cash, cash flows and dividends as the company tagged them (IFRS concepts, its currency, full scale), with the comparatives, the report's viewer link and the other years on file. Issuers on EU and EEA regulated markets, found by name or LEI; words find any other tagged figure.

company.description: Company name (ASML, LVMH, TotalEnergies) or its LEI (724500Y6DUVHQD6OXN27).

words.description: Also find the report's other figures whose concept names hold these words ("net system sales", "lease liabilities").

year.description: Fiscal year the report covers (the year its period ends); default the latest filed.

name: european_filings

outputSchema.description: facts is a table of measure, IFRS concept, period, value (full scale), unit and decimals, newest period first.

title: European filings (ESEF)
